svg.title: Early Edition Kids: how it fits together
svg.desc: A CronJob on the home k3s cluster calls the server at 05:30. The server fetches news feeds, uses an AI model to select, rewrite and check about six stories, and stores them in SQLite. The Kindle downloads the paper over the LAN from port 8080 and sends back what was read. A parent reaches the dashboard on port 8081 over HTTPS through Authelia. A nightly job backs the database up to a NAS.
svg.text: From the news feeds to the Kindle, every morning
Feeds in, about six stories out:
picked, rewritten and checked by AI.
The Kindle fetches it on waking
It can't wake itself, so the paper
See what was read, hide or add
stories, and choose the AI model.
